# Vendored: saulabs/trueskill

Source: https://github.com/saulabs/trueskill at commit d15b0752cb4be5ff27f26e5dbbac520680446355 (MIT, see LICENSE).

The upstream project is unmaintained, and its gemspec calls `has_rdoc=`, which RubyGems 4 (Ruby 4.0) removed. The only change from upstream is deleting that line from `trueskill.gemspec`. The library code in `lib/` is unmodified.
